sharedLedgerEvidence: Legacy deposits now check durable operation caps and insert the reservation in one immediate SQLite transaction; independent-connection concurrency tests pass.
Legacy tickets bind to a durable ledger identity; missing or already-settled rows and tickets from another ledger cannot overwrite cost.

The additive investigation allowance API keeps revision history, pins an explicit model, counts all potential provider attempts, protects review/report calls, and retains unresolved reservations after restart.
Allowance tests cover stale revisions, separate workers, cancellation, request-id reuse, unknown cost, and explicit allowance revision without resetting consumption.

An explicitly bound LangGraph runtime now exchanges durable provider reservations before transport, including internal turns, quota retries, outer retries and next-step calls. Offline process tests preserve the selected GPT-5.5 medium configuration, protect review across workers, retain interrupted reservations and preserve tracing/failure-artifact consumption.

Prepared dispatch validates allowanceRef and the explicit model before runtime preflight, derives category from the descriptor, and propagates a binding that nested dispatch cannot replace. Campaign allowance approval/status are available through shared execution; approval starts no jobs.

Exact discovery campaign plans can now be attached to allowance approvals. Shared dispatch checks prepared input, indexed source identity and configuration, then claims attempts atomically across workers. Started attempts survive cancellation and restart; revisions cannot erase or repurpose them. The existing campaign dispatcher attaches references and counts quota failures against finite attempts.
limits: Accepted discovery scan batches bind their jobs automatically. Context, review and learning job planning, immutable context isolation and the guided editor remain open. Unbound legacy calls retain prior behavior. Allowance-only approval requires 80×24; combined finite work approval requires 120×36 until the paged editor is implemented.
Existing dollar deposits are estimates, not conservative upper bounds. Legacy hard ceilings remain per-handle settings.
Runtime query receipts may aggregate internal model turns and repair/retry attempts. Post-receipt stop checks cannot bound dollar overshoot.
Unknown legacy spend retains the estimate, which may be below an observed incomplete subtotal. The investigation ledger separately records cost completeness.
resourceAudit.nextBoundary: Bind every accepted finite campaign job to its exact allowance, source and context; present approval/status through the dedicated responsive editor, and preserve those associations across restart.
